label: preparing
what: A surprise tribute for my forty years as mayor, in the great hall at 18:00, disguised as Builder's lighting inspection. My journal records Secretary revealing the purpose, Innkeeper arranging bread and Freight delivering it. Secretary and Freight are now seeking a personally guaranteed 48-emerald loan for Innkeeper to obtain 72 additional tribute loaves from Baker. Baker is involved in bread supply discussions, though his knowledge of the surprise itself is less certain. No loan has been authorized, and the empty grain stall obstructs additional baking.
